title: Perk numbers and clearer descriptions
summary: The bar along the bottom of the perks menu now shows each perk's key numbers, with hearts drawn as hearts, and hovering a point shows what it would change. Every perk has a clearer description, in every language. Perks that aren't ready yet show as Coming soon, and anyone can now offer their Live Eye to a viewer by name.
highlights: Key numbers for every perk in the perks bar
Clearer perk descriptions in every language
Perks that aren't ready yet show as Coming soon
Offer your Live Eye to a chosen viewer, no perk needed
